title: Layer 3 round 5 major security: the machine form renders state-sourced strings (phase, scope, domains) and the diagnostic file/message RAW — the last uncleaned sink; contradicts the text.rs scope claim that the policy covers the machine rendering

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 52f94321: state-sourced display strings (current_phase, active_composition scope/domains) are cleaned at the read_state source boundary — the peer of the acquisition's snapshot cleaning and the loader's PostLoad — so all three render forms including the MACHINE form receive clean data, and the #749 verbatim composition echo stays an echo of already-clean state. The broken machine block now reuses the cleaned path and message and cleans the kind. Pinned by a machine-form falsifier (hostile scope via state renders clean; hostile diagnostic path/message clean on both broken surfaces). The last uncleaned sink is closed at the source, not the sink.
